authors: I. Jack, D.R.T. Jones, S.P. Martin, M.T. Vaughn, Y. Yamada
title: Decoupling of the epsilon-scalar mass in softly broken supersymmetry
claim: In DRED for softly broken SUSY an unphysical epsilon-scalar mass is required for renormalization and enters the two-loop scalar-mass beta function; a redefinition of scalar masses (DRED' scheme) removes this dependence; earlier DR-bar one-loop calculations that ignored m~^2 effectively used DRED'.
symmetry_argument: Not a SUSY-preservation argument; scheme redefinition to decouple an evanescent mass.

proved: Decoupling of m~^2 from beta functions by redefinition (at the order treated).

evidence: arXiv abstract; S2.09 Sec. 6 eqs. (40)-(41) summarise the construction.
red_flags: Shows that even in SUSY theories DRED needs evanescent mass parameters once SUSY is softly broken.
notes: Lead check: the arXiv id given in the brief (hep-ph/9406207) is wrong (it is an unrelated B-meson paper); correct id hep-ph/9407291.
